WI:SCI.CC1.K-2.cc_advanced: I can find a pattern in nature or in things people make and use it to predict what will happen next.
WI:SCI.CC1.K-2.cc_at_target: I can observe patterns in the natural and designed world and use them to describe what I see and as evidence.
WI:SCI.CC1.K-2.cc_approaching: I can point to a simple pattern, like day and night, with help to explain it.
WI:SCI.CC1.K-2.cc_emerging: I can notice when things repeat, such as colors or shapes, using pictures and objects.

WI:SCI.CC1.3-5.cc_advanced: I can create my own way to classify objects and use patterns over time, like rates or cycles, to make and test predictions.
WI:SCI.CC1.3-5.cc_at_target: I can sort and classify objects by similarities and differences and use patterns over time, like cycles, to make predictions.
WI:SCI.CC1.3-5.cc_approaching: I can sort objects into groups using given rules and describe a simple cycle, with support.
WI:SCI.CC1.3-5.cc_emerging: I can say how two objects are the same or different, using pictures.

WI:SCI.CC1.m.cc_advanced: I can use patterns in data to argue for a cause and link a large-scale pattern to particle-level structure in a new example.
WI:SCI.CC1.m.cc_at_target: I can connect large-scale patterns to atomic structure, find patterns in rates and numbers, and use patterns to identify cause and effect.
WI:SCI.CC1.m.cc_approaching: I can identify a pattern in a graph or table and say what it shows, with sentence frames.
WI:SCI.CC1.m.cc_emerging: I can describe a pattern I see in a picture or data table, with teacher support.

WI:SCI.CC1.h.cc_advanced: I can show how a pattern changes at different scales and use this to improve an investigation or redesign a system.
WI:SCI.CC1.h.cc_at_target: I can observe patterns at different scales, use them as evidence for causes, and use math to analyze patterns in systems.
WI:SCI.CC1.h.cc_approaching: I can identify a pattern in data and explain what it suggests about cause, with guided questions.
WI:SCI.CC1.h.cc_emerging: I can describe a pattern in a graph or data set, with support.

WI:SCI.CC2.K-2.cc_advanced: I can design my own simple test to check an idea about what causes something and explain the result.
WI:SCI.CC2.K-2.cc_at_target: I can say that events have causes and do simple tests to gather evidence for or against my ideas about causes.
WI:SCI.CC2.K-2.cc_approaching: I can say what caused a simple change, like ice melting in the sun, with help.
WI:SCI.CC2.K-2.cc_emerging: I can notice that something happened after an action, such as a ball rolling after a push.

WI:SCI.CC2.3-5.cc_advanced: I can test a cause-and-effect idea, use it to explain a change, and explain why two things happening together may not mean one caused the other.
WI:SCI.CC2.3-5.cc_at_target: I can identify and test cause-and-effect relationships to explain change and know that things happening together are not always cause and effect.
WI:SCI.CC2.3-5.cc_approaching: I can describe a cause and its effect in an investigation, using a cause-and-effect chart.
WI:SCI.CC2.3-5.cc_emerging: I can match a cause to its effect using pictures, with support.

WI:SCI.CC2.m.cc_advanced: I can analyze data to decide if a relationship is causal or correlational and explain a phenomenon with more than one cause.
WI:SCI.CC2.m.cc_at_target: I can classify relationships as causal or correlational, use cause and effect to predict phenomena, and recognize that events can have several causes.
WI:SCI.CC2.m.cc_approaching: I can identify a cause and effect relationship in data and use it to make a prediction, with support.
WI:SCI.CC2.m.cc_emerging: I can describe what caused a change in an investigation, using sentence frames.

WI:SCI.CC2.h.cc_advanced: I can propose and test a causal mechanism in a complex system and explain why some causes have bigger effects than others.
WI:SCI.CC2.h.cc_at_target: I can use evidence to tell cause from correlation and suggest cause-and-effect relationships to explain and predict behavior of complex systems.
WI:SCI.CC2.h.cc_approaching: I can explain whether data shows cause or only correlation, with guided questions.
WI:SCI.CC2.h.cc_emerging: I can identify a possible cause for an observed change, with support.

WI:SCI.CC3.K-2.cc_advanced: I can compare several objects using relative scales and measure lengths accurately in standard units.
WI:SCI.CC3.K-2.cc_at_target: I can use words like bigger, hotter, and faster to describe objects and use standard units to measure length.
WI:SCI.CC3.K-2.cc_approaching: I can compare two objects as bigger or smaller and measure with help.
WI:SCI.CC3.K-2.cc_emerging: I can point to the bigger or smaller of two objects.

WI:SCI.CC3.3-5.cc_advanced: I can choose the right tool and units to measure a quantity and compare things from very small to very large.
WI:SCI.CC3.3-5.cc_at_target: I can recognize that things exist from very small to very large and measure mass, time, temperature, and volume in standard units.
WI:SCI.CC3.3-5.cc_approaching: I can measure mass or temperature with a tool and record the units, with support.
WI:SCI.CC3.3-5.cc_emerging: I can read a ruler or thermometer with help.

WI:SCI.CC3.m.cc_advanced: I can use models and proportional reasoning to explain how a system's behavior changes with scale.
WI:SCI.CC3.m.cc_at_target: I can use models to study systems too large or too small to observe and understand that what is seen at one scale may not be seen at another.
WI:SCI.CC3.m.cc_approaching: I can use a scale model or diagram to compare sizes or distances, with support.
WI:SCI.CC3.m.cc_emerging: I can say that some things are too small or too far away to see without tools.

WI:SCI.CC3.h.cc_advanced: I can use math and models to compare a phenomenon at several scales and explain how scale changes its importance.
WI:SCI.CC3.h.cc_at_target: I can explain that the importance of a phenomenon depends on its scale, proportion, and quantity and that some systems can only be studied indirectly.
WI:SCI.CC3.h.cc_approaching: I can use ratios or scientific notation to compare quantities, with a worked example.
WI:SCI.CC3.h.cc_emerging: I can compare quantities that are very large or very small, with support.

WI:SCI.CC4.K-2.cc_advanced: I can explain how the parts of an object or living thing work together and what happens if one part is missing.
WI:SCI.CC4.K-2.cc_at_target: I can describe objects and living things by their parts and explain that parts of a system work together.
WI:SCI.CC4.K-2.cc_approaching: I can name the parts of an object or living thing, with help.
WI:SCI.CC4.K-2.cc_emerging: I can point to parts of an object, like the wheels of a toy car.

WI:SCI.CC4.3-5.cc_advanced: I can describe a system, explain how its parts interact, and predict what happens when one part changes.
WI:SCI.CC4.3-5.cc_at_target: I can explain that a system is a group of related parts that work together to do things the parts cannot do alone.
WI:SCI.CC4.3-5.cc_approaching: I can name the parts of a system and say what one part does, with support.
WI:SCI.CC4.3-5.cc_emerging: I can name parts of a simple system, using a diagram.

WI:SCI.CC4.m.cc_advanced: I can model a system with sub-systems and use the model to predict how a change in inputs affects outputs.
WI:SCI.CC4.m.cc_at_target: I can use models to show how systems interact, including inputs, processes, outputs, and flows of energy, matter, and information.
WI:SCI.CC4.m.cc_approaching: I can label inputs and outputs of a system on a model, with support.
WI:SCI.CC4.m.cc_emerging: I can identify the parts of a system in a diagram, with help.

WI:SCI.CC4.h.cc_advanced: I can build and test a model of interacting systems and explain its limits and assumptions.
WI:SCI.CC4.h.cc_at_target: I can define a system's boundaries, inputs, and outputs and use models to simulate flows of energy and matter within and between systems.
WI:SCI.CC4.h.cc_approaching: I can describe a system's boundaries and inputs and outputs, with a template.
WI:SCI.CC4.h.cc_emerging: I can name parts of a system and what goes in and out, with support.

WI:SCI.CC5.K-2.cc_advanced: I can predict and test how an object can be taken apart or built into a new object.
WI:SCI.CC5.K-2.cc_at_target: I can observe that objects can break into smaller pieces, be put together into larger pieces, or change shape.
WI:SCI.CC5.K-2.cc_approaching: I can show how blocks can be taken apart and put together, with help.
WI:SCI.CC5.K-2.cc_emerging: I can notice when an object changes shape.

WI:SCI.CC5.3-5.cc_advanced: I can track matter and energy through a process and use measurements to show total mass stays the same.
WI:SCI.CC5.3-5.cc_at_target: I can explain that matter is made of particles, energy can be transferred, and the total mass of matter stays the same during changes.
WI:SCI.CC5.3-5.cc_approaching: I can measure mass before and after a change and compare, with support.
WI:SCI.CC5.3-5.cc_emerging: I can say that energy can move from one object to another, using examples.

WI:SCI.CC5.m.cc_advanced: I can trace energy and matter through a system and explain how energy transfer drives the cycling of matter.
WI:SCI.CC5.m.cc_at_target: I can explain that matter is conserved because atoms are conserved and that energy transfer drives the motion and cycling of matter.
WI:SCI.CC5.m.cc_approaching: I can show with a model that atoms are rearranged but not lost, with support.
WI:SCI.CC5.m.cc_emerging: I can name forms of energy and say that matter is made of atoms.

WI:SCI.CC5.h.cc_advanced: I can quantify energy and matter flows in a system and use them to predict changes.
WI:SCI.CC5.h.cc_at_target: I can explain that energy and matter are conserved in closed systems and describe changes as flows into, out of, and within a system.
WI:SCI.CC5.h.cc_approaching: I can track energy or matter in a simple system diagram, with support.
WI:SCI.CC5.h.cc_emerging: I can say that energy cannot be created or destroyed, with a diagram.

WI:SCI.CC6.K-2.cc_advanced: I can design an object with a shape that helps it do a job and explain why.
WI:SCI.CC6.K-2.cc_at_target: I can observe that the shape and stability of natural and designed objects are related to what they do.
WI:SCI.CC6.K-2.cc_approaching: I can say how one object's shape helps it work, such as a round wheel, with help.
WI:SCI.CC6.K-2.cc_emerging: I can name shapes of everyday objects.

WI:SCI.CC6.3-5.cc_advanced: I can explain how the parts and materials of an object or organism help it do its job and suggest a better design.
WI:SCI.CC6.3-5.cc_at_target: I can explain that different materials have substructures with shapes and parts that serve functions.
WI:SCI.CC6.3-5.cc_approaching: I can describe how one part of an object or living thing helps it work, with support.
WI:SCI.CC6.3-5.cc_emerging: I can name parts of an object or living thing, using pictures.

WI:SCI.CC6.m.cc_advanced: I can design a structure for a purpose by choosing its shape, materials, and parts, and justify my choices.
WI:SCI.CC6.m.cc_at_target: I can model complex and microscopic structures and explain how their function depends on their shape, composition, and parts.
WI:SCI.CC6.m.cc_approaching: I can explain how the structure of one thing, like a cell part, is related to its job, with support.
WI:SCI.CC6.m.cc_emerging: I can match a structure to its function, using a word bank.

WI:SCI.CC6.h.cc_advanced: I can analyze a system's materials and structure to solve a design problem and justify my solution.
WI:SCI.CC6.h.cc_at_target: I can investigate materials, structures, and connections to reveal how a system functions and infer function from structure.
WI:SCI.CC6.h.cc_approaching: I can explain how a material's property makes it useful for a job, with guided questions.
WI:SCI.CC6.h.cc_emerging: I can describe a property of a material, such as strength, with support.

WI:SCI.CC7.K-2.cc_advanced: I can compare fast and slow changes and predict whether something will change or stay the same.
WI:SCI.CC7.K-2.cc_at_target: I can observe that some things stay the same while others change, slowly or quickly.
WI:SCI.CC7.K-2.cc_approaching: I can say whether something changed fast or slow, with help.
WI:SCI.CC7.K-2.cc_emerging: I can notice that something has changed, using before and after pictures.

WI:SCI.CC7.3-5.cc_advanced: I can measure and compare rates of change and explain how a stable system can change over a long time.
WI:SCI.CC7.3-5.cc_at_target: I can measure change over time, notice that change happens at different rates, and explain that stable systems can change over long periods.
WI:SCI.CC7.3-5.cc_approaching: I can record measurements over time and describe a change, with support.
WI:SCI.CC7.3-5.cc_emerging: I can describe how something changed from one day to another.

WI:SCI.CC7.m.cc_advanced: I can explain how a small change in one part of a system caused a large change in another part, with evidence.
WI:SCI.CC7.m.cc_at_target: I can explain stability and change in systems by examining changes over time and forces at different scales, including feedback and equilibrium.
WI:SCI.CC7.m.cc_approaching: I can describe a change in a system and say what caused it, with support.
WI:SCI.CC7.m.cc_emerging: I can say whether a system stayed the same or changed, using data.

WI:SCI.CC7.h.cc_advanced: I can model how feedback stabilizes or destabilizes a system and predict long-term changes.
WI:SCI.CC7.h.cc_at_target: I can quantify and model changes in systems over short and long periods and explain how feedback can stabilize or destabilize a system.
WI:SCI.CC7.h.cc_approaching: I can identify positive or negative feedback in a system diagram, with support.
WI:SCI.CC7.h.cc_emerging: I can describe a change in a system over time, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP1.A.K-2.cc_advanced: I can ask several testable questions about something I observe and choose one to investigate.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.K-2.cc_at_target: I can ask simple questions based on observations and identify questions that can be answered by an investigation.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.K-2.cc_approaching: I can ask a question about what I see, using a question starter.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.K-2.cc_emerging: I can wonder about something I see and share it with a partner, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP1.A.3-5.cc_advanced: I can ask testable questions about changing a variable and predict outcomes based on patterns.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.3-5.cc_at_target: I can ask questions about what happens when a variable changes and tell testable from non-testable questions.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.3-5.cc_approaching: I can ask a 'what would happen if' question, using question stems.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.3-5.cc_emerging: I can ask a question about an object or event, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP1.A.m.cc_advanced: I can ask questions that clarify a model or argument and refine them into testable research questions.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.m.cc_at_target: I can ask questions that specify relationships between variables and clarify arguments and models.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.m.cc_approaching: I can ask a testable question with an independent and dependent variable, using a template.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.m.cc_emerging: I can ask a question about an observation, using question starters.

WI:SCI.SEP1.A.h.cc_advanced: I can formulate and refine questions that can be investigated in the lab and evaluate them for testability and relevance.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.h.cc_at_target: I can ask questions to formulate, refine, and evaluate empirically testable questions from observations, models, and unexpected results.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.h.cc_approaching: I can write a testable question from an observation, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP1.A.h.cc_emerging: I can ask a question about a phenomenon, using question starters.

WI:SCI.SEP1.B.K-2.cc_advanced: I can define a problem and explain what a good solution would need to do.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.K-2.cc_at_target: I can define a simple problem that can be solved with a new or improved object or tool.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.K-2.cc_approaching: I can describe a problem I see, with help.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.K-2.cc_emerging: I can say something that is not working well, using pictures.

WI:SCI.SEP1.B.3-5.cc_advanced: I can define a design problem with clear criteria for success and constraints, using science ideas.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.3-5.cc_at_target: I can describe and define a simple design problem that includes several criteria for success and constraints on materials, time, or cost.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.3-5.cc_approaching: I can name a design problem and one criterion for success, with a template.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.3-5.cc_emerging: I can describe a problem that could be solved by making something.

WI:SCI.SEP1.B.m.cc_advanced: I can define a design problem precisely, including scientific limits, and rank the criteria and constraints.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.m.cc_at_target: I can define a design problem with multiple criteria and constraints, including scientific knowledge that may limit solutions.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.m.cc_approaching: I can list criteria and constraints for a design problem, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.m.cc_emerging: I can describe a design problem, using sentence frames.

WI:SCI.SEP1.B.h.cc_advanced: I can use models or simulations to refine a design problem with social, technical, and environmental criteria.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.h.cc_at_target: I can formulate, refine, and evaluate design problems with interacting parts and criteria and constraints, using models and simulations.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.h.cc_approaching: I can write a design problem with criteria and constraints, using a template.
WI:SCI.SEP1.B.h.cc_emerging: I can describe a design problem, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP2.K-2.cc_advanced: I can make a model, compare it to the real thing, and improve it.
WI:SCI.SEP2.K-2.cc_at_target: I can use and develop models such as drawings and physical replicas to represent real events or design solutions.
WI:SCI.SEP2.K-2.cc_approaching: I can make a drawing or simple model of an object, with help.
WI:SCI.SEP2.K-2.cc_emerging: I can tell the difference between a model and the real object.

WI:SCI.SEP2.3-5.cc_advanced: I can build and revise a model using evidence and explain its limitations.
WI:SCI.SEP2.3-5.cc_at_target: I can build and revise simple models and use them to represent events and design solutions.
WI:SCI.SEP2.3-5.cc_approaching: I can use a model to show how something works, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP2.3-5.cc_emerging: I can label a simple model or diagram, with a word bank.

WI:SCI.SEP2.m.cc_advanced: I can develop and revise a model based on evidence and use it to predict what happens when a variable changes.
WI:SCI.SEP2.m.cc_at_target: I can develop, use, and revise models to describe, test, and predict abstract phenomena and design systems.
WI:SCI.SEP2.m.cc_approaching: I can use a given model to explain a phenomenon, with guided questions.
WI:SCI.SEP2.m.cc_emerging: I can identify the parts of a model, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP2.h.cc_advanced: I can compare two models of the same thing, evaluate their merits and limits, and synthesize a better model.
WI:SCI.SEP2.h.cc_at_target: I can use, synthesize, and develop models to predict and show relationships among variables and between systems and their parts.
WI:SCI.SEP2.h.cc_approaching: I can use a model to show relationships between variables, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP2.h.cc_emerging: I can describe what a model shows, with sentence frames.

WI:SCI.SEP3.K-2.cc_advanced: I can plan a fair test with a partner, make careful observations, and use data to answer my question.
WI:SCI.SEP3.K-2.cc_at_target: I can plan and carry out simple investigations, based on fair tests, with peers, and make observations to collect data.
WI:SCI.SEP3.K-2.cc_approaching: I can follow steps to carry out an investigation and record what I see, with help.
WI:SCI.SEP3.K-2.cc_emerging: I can observe an investigation and share one thing I noticed.

WI:SCI.SEP3.3-5.cc_advanced: I can plan and carry out a fair test, control variables, and run several trials to produce reliable evidence.
WI:SCI.SEP3.3-5.cc_at_target: I can plan and carry out investigations that control variables and give evidence to support explanations or design solutions.
WI:SCI.SEP3.3-5.cc_approaching: I can follow a plan for a fair test and record measurements, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP3.3-5.cc_emerging: I can carry out simple steps of an investigation, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP3.m.cc_advanced: I can plan an investigation with independent and dependent variables and controls, collect accurate data, and evaluate my method.
WI:SCI.SEP3.m.cc_at_target: I can plan and carry out investigations with multiple variables that provide evidence for explanations or solutions.
WI:SCI.SEP3.m.cc_approaching: I can identify the variables in an investigation and collect data, with a planning template.
WI:SCI.SEP3.m.cc_emerging: I can follow a lab procedure safely and record data, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP3.h.cc_advanced: I can design an investigation, decide the data and precision needed, and use results to revise a model.
WI:SCI.SEP3.h.cc_at_target: I can plan and carry out investigations that give evidence to build and test conceptual, mathematical, physical, and empirical models.
WI:SCI.SEP3.h.cc_approaching: I can plan an investigation with variables and controls, using a template.
WI:SCI.SEP3.h.cc_emerging: I can follow a lab procedure and record data accurately, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP4.K-2.cc_advanced: I can record observations in different ways and use them to describe a pattern and answer a question.
WI:SCI.SEP4.K-2.cc_at_target: I can collect, record, and share observations using pictures, drawings, or writing and use them to describe patterns.
WI:SCI.SEP4.K-2.cc_approaching: I can draw or record what I observe, with help.
WI:SCI.SEP4.K-2.cc_emerging: I can tell a partner what I see.

WI:SCI.SEP4.3-5.cc_advanced: I can choose the best graph for my data and use it to explain a pattern and refine a design.
WI:SCI.SEP4.3-5.cc_at_target: I can collect data, show it in tables and graphs, and analyze it to reveal patterns.
WI:SCI.SEP4.3-5.cc_approaching: I can put data into a table or bar graph, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP4.3-5.cc_emerging: I can read one value from a simple table or graph, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP4.m.cc_advanced: I can analyze large data sets, tell correlation from causation, and use error analysis to judge my results.
WI:SCI.SEP4.m.cc_at_target: I can construct and interpret graphs and data sets to find relationships, telling correlation from causation and using basic statistics.
WI:SCI.SEP4.m.cc_approaching: I can make a graph and describe the trend it shows, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP4.m.cc_emerging: I can read values from a graph or table, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP4.h.cc_advanced: I can use statistics and models to compare data sets, judge consistency, and optimize a design.
WI:SCI.SEP4.h.cc_at_target: I can analyze data using tools and models, compare data sets for consistency, and make valid and reliable claims.
WI:SCI.SEP4.h.cc_approaching: I can analyze a data set for trends and outliers, with guided steps.
WI:SCI.SEP4.h.cc_emerging: I can make a graph from data and describe it, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP5.K-2.cc_advanced: I can use counting and measuring to compare objects and display data to answer a question.
WI:SCI.SEP5.K-2.cc_at_target: I can use counting and numbers to describe patterns and measure and compare attributes of objects.
WI:SCI.SEP5.K-2.cc_approaching: I can count objects and say which group has more, with help.
WI:SCI.SEP5.K-2.cc_emerging: I can count objects in a group.

WI:SCI.SEP5.3-5.cc_advanced: I can use math to analyze data and compare design solutions, explaining which is best.
WI:SCI.SEP5.3-5.cc_at_target: I can measure physical properties and use math to organize data, find patterns, and compare design solutions.
WI:SCI.SEP5.3-5.cc_approaching: I can measure and record quantities and find a simple total or difference, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP5.3-5.cc_emerging: I can measure with a tool and write the number, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP5.m.cc_advanced: I can use digital tools and math to find trends in large data sets and use them to support an argument.
WI:SCI.SEP5.m.cc_at_target: I can find patterns in large data sets and use math concepts such as ratio and rate to support explanations and arguments.
WI:SCI.SEP5.m.cc_approaching: I can calculate a rate or ratio from data, with a worked example.
WI:SCI.SEP5.m.cc_emerging: I can do a simple calculation with data, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP5.h.cc_advanced: I can create a computational simulation from math models and use it to test a claim or design.
WI:SCI.SEP5.h.cc_at_target: I can use algebra, functions, and computational tools to analyze, represent, and model data.
WI:SCI.SEP5.h.cc_approaching: I can use an equation to calculate values from data, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP5.h.cc_emerging: I can substitute values into a given formula, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP6.A.K-2.cc_advanced: I can explain what happened using evidence from several observations.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.K-2.cc_at_target: I can use observations to make an evidence-based account of a natural event.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.K-2.cc_approaching: I can tell what happened and give one observation as evidence, with sentence frames.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.K-2.cc_emerging: I can describe what I saw happen.

WI:SCI.SEP6.A.3-5.cc_advanced: I can use evidence to explain a phenomenon and predict what will happen if a variable changes.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.3-5.cc_at_target: I can use evidence such as measurements and patterns to construct explanations that describe and predict phenomena.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.3-5.cc_approaching: I can write an explanation with one piece of evidence, using a claim-evidence frame.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.3-5.cc_emerging: I can say what I think happened and why, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP6.A.m.cc_advanced: I can construct an explanation using several sources of evidence and scientific reasoning and apply it to a new situation.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.m.cc_at_target: I can construct explanations supported by multiple sources of evidence that are consistent with scientific ideas and theories.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.m.cc_approaching: I can write a claim, evidence, and reasoning explanation, using a template.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.m.cc_emerging: I can make a claim and give one piece of evidence, using sentence frames.

WI:SCI.SEP6.A.h.cc_advanced: I can construct and revise an explanation using independent evidence I generated and theories, and judge its limits.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.h.cc_at_target: I can create explanations supported by multiple independent sources of my own evidence and consistent with scientific ideas and theories.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.h.cc_approaching: I can write a claim, evidence, and reasoning explanation using data, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP6.A.h.cc_emerging: I can make a claim and support it with one piece of evidence, with sentence frames.

WI:SCI.SEP6.B.K-2.cc_advanced: I can build more than one solution to a problem and explain which works best.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.K-2.cc_at_target: I can use tools and materials to design and build a device that solves a problem and compare different solutions.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.K-2.cc_approaching: I can build a solution to a problem following a plan, with help.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.K-2.cc_emerging: I can share an idea for solving a problem, using a drawing.

WI:SCI.SEP6.B.3-5.cc_advanced: I can apply science ideas to create several solutions and use test data to choose the best one.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.3-5.cc_at_target: I can apply scientific ideas to create multiple solutions to a design problem and compare how well they meet criteria and constraints.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.3-5.cc_approaching: I can make two solutions and compare them using a checklist, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.3-5.cc_emerging: I can make one solution to a problem, with help.

WI:SCI.SEP6.B.m.cc_advanced: I can design, build, test, and optimize a solution using science principles and data from several trials.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.m.cc_at_target: I can apply scientific ideas to design, construct, and test an object, tool, process, or system supported by multiple sources of evidence.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.m.cc_approaching: I can build and test a design and make one improvement, with a design template.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.m.cc_emerging: I can build a design from a plan, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP6.B.h.cc_advanced: I can design, evaluate, and refine a solution to a complex real-world problem, using my own evidence and trade-off analysis.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.h.cc_at_target: I can create designs supported by multiple independent sources of my own evidence and consistent with scientific ideas and principles.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.h.cc_approaching: I can design and test a solution and use data to improve it, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP6.B.h.cc_emerging: I can propose a design solution and explain it, with sentence frames.

WI:SCI.SEP7.K-2.cc_advanced: I can make a claim, support it with evidence, and explain why some evidence is better than other evidence.
WI:SCI.SEP7.K-2.cc_at_target: I can compare ideas, identify arguments supported by evidence, and construct an argument with evidence to support a claim.
WI:SCI.SEP7.K-2.cc_approaching: I can make a claim and give one reason, using a sentence frame.
WI:SCI.SEP7.K-2.cc_emerging: I can say whether I agree or disagree with an idea.

WI:SCI.SEP7.3-5.cc_advanced: I can critique a peer's explanation with evidence and improve my own argument based on feedback.
WI:SCI.SEP7.3-5.cc_at_target: I can critique explanations or solutions proposed by peers by citing relevant evidence and construct arguments with evidence, data, or a model.
WI:SCI.SEP7.3-5.cc_approaching: I can support a claim with evidence and respond to a peer's idea, using sentence frames.
WI:SCI.SEP7.3-5.cc_emerging: I can make a claim and share one reason, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP7.m.cc_advanced: I can compare and critique two arguments and construct a convincing written and oral argument with empirical evidence.
WI:SCI.SEP7.m.cc_at_target: I can construct a convincing argument that supports or refutes claims for explanations or solutions, using evidence and reasoning.
WI:SCI.SEP7.m.cc_approaching: I can write an argument with a claim, evidence, and reasoning, using a template.
WI:SCI.SEP7.m.cc_emerging: I can state a claim and one piece of evidence, using sentence frames.

WI:SCI.SEP7.h.cc_advanced: I can evaluate competing arguments from science history or current issues and respectfully critique reasoning and evidence.
WI:SCI.SEP7.h.cc_at_target: I can use appropriate and sufficient evidence and scientific reasoning to defend and critique claims and explanations.
WI:SCI.SEP7.h.cc_approaching: I can defend a claim with evidence and respond to one counterargument, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP7.h.cc_emerging: I can state a claim and give evidence for it, using sentence frames.

WI:SCI.SEP8.K-2.cc_advanced: I can find information in texts and media, describe how it answers my question, and share it in several ways.
WI:SCI.SEP8.K-2.cc_at_target: I can read texts or use media to get science information, use it to find patterns or evidence, and communicate it.
WI:SCI.SEP8.K-2.cc_approaching: I can find one fact in a picture book or video and share it, with help.
WI:SCI.SEP8.K-2.cc_emerging: I can look at pictures in a book and say what I learned.

WI:SCI.SEP8.3-5.cc_advanced: I can combine information from several texts and media and evaluate how well the evidence supports the ideas.
WI:SCI.SEP8.3-5.cc_at_target: I can read and summarize science texts and media, describe how ideas are supported by evidence, and communicate information.
WI:SCI.SEP8.3-5.cc_approaching: I can find key information in a text or chart and summarize it, with a graphic organizer.
WI:SCI.SEP8.3-5.cc_emerging: I can find one fact in a text or picture, with support.

WI:SCI.SEP8.m.cc_advanced: I can evaluate the credibility of several sources, synthesize their information, and present it clearly to an audience.
WI:SCI.SEP8.m.cc_at_target: I can critically read science texts, evaluate the merit of ideas and methods, and communicate information in several formats.
WI:SCI.SEP8.m.cc_approaching: I can find the central idea of a science text and summarize it, with support.
WI:SCI.SEP8.m.cc_emerging: I can find key words and facts in a science text, with a word bank.

WI:SCI.SEP8.h.cc_advanced: I can critically read scientific literature, evaluate competing claims, and communicate complex information in multiple formats.
WI:SCI.SEP8.h.cc_at_target: I can evaluate the validity and reliability of claims, methods, and designs and communicate scientific information in multiple formats.
WI:SCI.SEP8.h.cc_approaching: I can summarize evidence from a scientific text and say if the source is reliable, with guided questions.
WI:SCI.SEP8.h.cc_emerging: I can find the main idea of a scientific text, with support.
